0022600026.text: The Boston Celtics (6-2, 5-0 at home, 1-2 on the road) are on a six-game... wait, I need to be accurate: they are 6-2 overall with a W1 streak and sit 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, while the Charlotte Hornets (3-6) have lost five straight and sit 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back. In this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, Boston is on the road and Charlotte is at home, with the Celtics owning a 1-2 road record. Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness) and Payton Pritchard (day-to-day, eye abrasion, game-time decision), while Charlotte is without Grant Williams (out, hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (day-to-day, leg soreness, game-time decision). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and the Celtics beat the Hornets 113-102 in Boston on April 7, 2026.
